scope: Screen additional open-source DXF parsers and 3D geometry importers for potential structural-carrier or explicit-geometry evidence roles, then update the existing plan without adding routine validation cost.

method.kind: Primary-source repository, release, and issue review
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing peer lineage, structural carrier, explicit mesh, ACIS/AcDs, consumer and composed-checkpoint gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: current finding/subplan totals and deferred external J-item status
method.limitations: Mutable README and source statements do not establish released runtime behavior. The dxfjs Solid3D field parser was not independently inspected or executed; the Assimp issue does not identify whether the input record was SOLID or 3DSOLID beyond the reporter's wording. No source-generated differential or semantic geometry result was produced.

evidence.observed: The mutable README lists 3DFACE and 3DSOLID, and the current ENTITIES dispatcher creates and calls a dedicated Solid3D parser. The public usage accepts text content. package.json on mutable main says 0.3.2, while the newest visible GitHub release is v0.3.0 at eb52655; the visible release notes do not establish when 3DSOLID support entered the published artifact.
doesNotEstablish: which exact published artifact contains the current Solid3D dispatch
complete handling or byte-for-byte retention of group codes 1, 3, and 310
DWG/AcDs association or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Discovery-only ASCII DXF structural-parser candidate. If a named composed-checkpoint question requires it, pin source and package artifact, verify source correspondence, and use one scratch-generated minimal 3DSOLID plus following sentinel. Record exact tags, group-310 byte concatenation/hash, identity, alignment, and diagnostics; do not add dependency or per-slice run.

evidence.observed: The project describes a C++ DXF data import/manipulation/export library with geometry extraction helpers, and its dxf2vrml example converts polygon data only. The 2019 OpenSCAD comparison labels DIME a 3D option but explicitly says the survey had not tested every library against all DXF cases.
doesNotEstablish: modern ACIS carrier preservation or parsing
B-rep validity or analytic solid semantics
complete CAD document or object graph round-trip
evidence.planUse: Optional explicit-polygon projection observation only if required by a named composed consumer question. Pin the revision/build and compare against a scratch-generated asymmetric WCS manifest. A VRML mesh is not document-preservation or ACIS evidence.

evidence.observed: Assimp is a general 3D asset importer. Its reopened #2645 report says an input DXF using SOLID produced a 'no 3d data' diagnostic; the issue has no current pinned runtime reproduction in this review. SOLID is a distinct record name from 3DSOLID.
doesNotEstablish: whether the reporter's file used SOLID or 3DSOLID wire grammar beyond the report text
CAD document preservation, writing, or DWG support
evidence.planUse: Do not use as a document completeness or ACIS oracle. Only consider a pinned, exact-record consumer projection check if a named issue requires it; any failure must be reduced to a source-authored minimal control before attribution.

readinessRefinement: keep structural DXF 3DSOLID carrier checks separate from ACIS parsing and B-rep semantics
keep explicit polygon projection separate from full DXF document preservation
run additional peers only at the existing composed checkpoint when a named evidence gap requires them
use scratch-generated controls and require immutable parser/source/artifact provenance
